firebase-crashlytics.author: Matthew Robertson
firebase-crashlytics.message:
Fix event timestamp on ANR events (#8612)

Fix event timestamp on ANR events

The event timestamp is in seconds, but
`ApplicationExitInfo.getTimestamp()` returns the timestamp of the
process's death in milliseconds, see
https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/ApplicationExitInfo#getTimestamp()

This was causing the backend to disregard the event timestamp, and
replace it with the current timestamp

Tested by generating an ANR event, waiting a few minutes, and then
uploading and comparing `event_time` to `queue_time`, see
https://paste.googleplex.com/5247760610230272

firebase-firestore.author: wu-hui
firebase-firestore.message:
test(firestore): use TARGET_DATABASE_ID in lifecycle integration tests (#8623)

### Summary
Pass `BuildConfig.TARGET_DATABASE_ID` to
`FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(app, BuildConfig.TARGET_DATABASE_ID)` in
`testRestartFirestoreLeadsToNewInstance()` and
`testAppDeleteLeadsToFirestoreTerminate()`.

### Context
When running Nightly integration tests against the regional
`us-central1-test-firestore.sandbox.googleapis.com` endpoint
(`TARGET_DATABASE_ID="enterprise"` in `us-central1`), calling
`FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(app)` defaults to the `(default)`
database (located in `nam5`), causing network writes in these two
lifecycle tests to time out.

ai-logic/firebase-ai.author: Rosário P. Fernandes
ai-logic/firebase-ai.message:
chore(ai, appcheck): ensure companion Kotlindocs are generated (#8575)

This PR configures the `kotlindoc` task dependencies for `firebase-ai`
and `firebase-appcheck` so that companion modules automatically have
their documentation generated whenever the parent SDK's documentation is
built:

- **`firebase-ai`** depends on
`:ai-logic:firebase-ai-ondevice:kotlindoc`.
- **`firebase-appcheck`** depends on:
    - `:appcheck:firebase-appcheck-debug:kotlindoc`
    - `:appcheck:firebase-appcheck-playintegrity:kotlindoc`
    - `:appcheck:firebase-appcheck-recaptcha:kotlindoc`

This ensures companion API reference docs are consistently generated and
packaged into `kotlindoc.zip` during `./gradlew firebasePublish` as well
as during local documentation builds.

ai-logic/firebase-ai.author: Mila
ai-logic/firebase-ai.message:
Mila extend header custom options (#8573)

This PR introduces support for configuring custom API client headers via
`RequestOptions`. It enables wrapper libraries and internal tools (like
ADK) to specify their own client identifiers when making requests to the
generative backend.

Changes include:
- Added a `customApiClientHeader` internal property to `RequestOptions`.
- Introduced `RequestOptionsFactory.createWithCustomHeader()` to allow
internal tools to create a copy of `RequestOptions` that includes the
custom header.
- Updated `GenerativeModel`, `LiveGenerativeModel`, and
`TemplateGenerativeModel` to read `customApiClientHeader` and append it
to their base `apiClient` string.
